sentences.en: The mathematical expressions of MTF for linear motion and sinusoidal vibration are developed.

sentences.en: This mechanism is called correspondence and allows MTF to traverse a whole model by applying all the correspondences reachable (directly or transitively) from the top-level relation.

sentences.en: METHODS: Retina MTF of two groups of people with emmetropia and ametropia were measured by means of a grating and parallel plate respectively. Then the measured MTF were compared and analyzed.

sentences.en: It is feasible that to use CCD device and image processing system in measurement of the modulation transfer function (MTF) of X-ray film and luminescent screen.

sentences.en: Least square regression method was used for MTF curve (at logarithmic axis) fitting with quadratic equation so as or cubic equation to obtain the desired parameters.
